title: Historical Violin Trade Datasets
description:
Historical Violin Trade Datasets gathers datasets on the historical trade in violins, built from primary sources: auction results checked against the houses' own documents, dealer and workshop ledgers, and published price catalogues.

Ledgers: the Lupot–Gand–Bernardel–Caressa–Français corpus at the Musée de la musique (Philharmonie de Paris), registers E.981.8.29 (purchase and resale, 1920–1944) and E.981.8.30 (export journal, 1926–1939), transcribed, normalised and cross-referenced.

Price catalogues: the American section of J. H. Fairfield, Known violin makers (1942; 4th ed. 1983), 176 entries coded by status and matched to the auction record.

Auction results, 1829–2026, one file per sale, each line with the source of its text and price: primary (the houses' own documents and results: 683 sales, 157 558 lots, 1968–2026, 16 houses including Vichy Enchères, Tarisio and Amati, words and prices unchanged), secondary (other sources where no house document is held, facts only: 1 369 files, 35 491 lots, 94 houses, 1829–2026) and press (contemporary reports: 85 files, 1 389 lots, 1857–1911).

resources.name: auction_results_raw
resources.description: Auction results of violin-family instruments and bows, one CSV per sale in each house's folder: primary files (690 sales as the houses published them; sales.csv = one line per primary sale), secondary files (_snd, 1 369) and press files (_press, 85); text_source / price_source per line; COVERAGE.md gives the shares.

resources.name: caressa_francais_ledger_1920_1944
resources.description: Violin transactions from the Lupot–Gand–Bernardel–Caressa–Français ledger corpus: purchase and resale register E.981.8.29 (1920–1944) and export journal E.981.8.30 (1926–1939).

resources.name: fairfield_1942_american_makers
resources.description: American makers listed with prices in Fairfield, Known violin makers (1942), coded by status and matched to the auction record (the study, with its scripts and outcomes, is in the Violin Auction Trends Analytics repository).
